== '''Deed Of Ravenshire''' ==
[[File:Deed of Ravenshire item.png|right|frameless]]
The Deed of Ravenshire is a quest item needed for the quest "[https://database.turtle-wow.org/?quest=40966&__cf_chl_tk=aPa.XtaTZCsPVAp5nvPExdRGpBQnb5gWs0XWRbdOlkI-1719182096-0.0.1.1-3604 ''The Deed to Raven''shire]" collected from the dungeon [[Gilneas City|''Gilneas City'']]. The item appears on the table right next to the Family Chest, right after killing both Lady and Lord Harlow.
